annotations.title: Run a job using prepaid RQM credits

description: Purchase one discovered service using prepaid credits within the account owner's saved spending policy. First search_buyer_jobs for the task and inspect the selected request_schema, required inputs, limits, examples and evidence boundaries. Use its buyer service_id as capability_id; validate the user's inputs and ask for missing data rather than substituting an example. Set max_total_price to the caller-approved USD ceiling; discovery is not a binding quote and balance alone is not policy authorization. Acceptance or a queued job is not completion: retain the returned job ID and use get_account_job to read saved status, result and receipt. If submission times out or its outcome is uncertain, first recover with list_account_jobs using the original idempotency_key. Any retry must preserve the same key, capability, request and price ceiling; never create a new purchase or switch payment rails to recover. This tool never signs x402 or funds the account. Report only observed completion and findings within the service's evidence boundaries.

capability_id.description: Buyer service_id returned by discovery, not an implementation_capability_id. Select a supported service before submitting.

idempotency_key.description: Stable caller-chosen identifier for one purchase. Preserve the exact key and request on retries; recover uncertain submissions with list_account_jobs using this key.

max_total_price.description: Caller-approved total price ceiling in USD as a decimal string with up to six fractional digits. Not a quote, funding instruction or policy authorization; the saved spending policy must also permit this job.

request.description: User inputs matching the selected service request_schema. Consult its required fields and example; ask for missing data, units, rules or tolerances rather than inventing them.

name: run_account_job

outputSchema.description: Unmodified Account Core submission response for the saved job. Acceptance does not establish completion; use the returned job ID to read saved status and available result and receipt.

title: Run a job using prepaid RQM credits
